newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela will not use IMF loan funds - Matos.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela will not use IMF loan funds - Matos.

text.p: Venezuela will not use the remainder of its $1.4 billion stand-by loan with the International Monetary Fund, Finance Minister Luis Raul Matos Azocar said Wednesday.
"Venezuela will follow the program but will not make use of the amount remaining with the IMF," Matos said during a breakfast meeting with foreign journalists.
The IMF approved the stand-by loan for Venezuela in July after the government launched an economic reform program.
The government received a first installment of about $500 but decided to eschew the remaining tranches of the loan after higher-than-expected oil prices boosted foreign reserves.
Foreign reserves have risen $5.7 billion, or 59 percent, since the government launched its reform program in mid-April.
